name: aio-pi-extensions
description: AIO sandbox default pi extension packages - the pi scenario's 'subset config'. Baked verbatim to /opt/pi-extensions at build time (npm install --omit=dev); registered into ~/.pi/agent/settings.json at runtime by aio-pi-extensions using local paths (zero network, works on offline docker-load machines). To add/remove/bump a package: edit dependencies below, then `make build-base` and re-run `aio-pi-extensions` once per machine.
